summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for LMV321IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5, opamp-single): evaluated 23 same-category OPNs and shortlisted the top 10 ranked replacements (1 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 0 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 9 Level 3 Layout Change). Verify pinout, thermal margin, lifecycle status, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

selection_checklist: Verify device class (opamp) and output stage (push-pull) — never substitute an uncompensated comparator for a compensated op-amp, or vice versa, without circuit redesign; only open-collector/open-drain outputs require an external pull-up.
Confirm supply rail span (2.7–5.5 V rec, 5.5 V abs max) and exact SOT-23-5 pinout (1=IN_POS, 2=VEE, 3=IN_NEG, 4=OUT, 5=VCC).
Verify input common-mode headroom (Non-RR-In), output swing (RR-Out), and Vos (7 mV max) against signal chain budget.
Check closed-loop bandwidth (GBWP / Acl), full-power slew rate (SR / 2π·Vpeak), and capacitive-load phase margin on the bench.
